Name: Human Connectome Project Multi-Modal Parcellation version 1.0
Description: A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex based on data from the Human Connectome Project. Contains 180 areas per hemisphere (360 total) defined using surface-based registration of cortical folding, myelin maps, and resting-state functional connectivity. Note: This volumetric version is provided for convenience but surface-based analysis is recommended for accurate localization.

Processing.res-01: Resampled from original 256x256x256 atlas using: flirt -in MNI_Glasser_HCP_v1.0.nii.gz -ref <res-01_reference> -out <output> -applyxfm -usesqform -interp nearestneighbour
Processing.res-02: Resampled from original 256x256x256 atlas using: flirt -in MNI_Glasser_HCP_v1.0.nii.gz -ref <res-02_reference> -out <output> -applyxfm -usesqform -interp nearestneighbour
